title: Lemmings
build: PAL disk release, three disks (Psygnosis 1994); the boot disk unpatched, analysed at the title and at level 1 of Fun

records.c: bit 7 set by the play interrupt once per screen swap ($0913); the main loop at $0E5F waits for it and clears it
the joystick byte read from $DC00 by $0B3C, shifted out bit by bit into $0402-$0406
five flags, $80 when pressed: up, down, left, right, fire (from $DC00 bits 0-4, by $0B3C)
first sprite row's Y for the terrain sprites: the scroll's coarse row offset plus $48 ($0B7B), set by $0CDF
how far the eight terrain sprites' X positions are rotated through $0413-$041A ($0BB4), set by $0CDF
terrain sprite multicolour 0, from the level header's colour table at $E060 ($0E1C)
terrain sprites' own colour, from $E064 ($0E1C)
terrain sprite multicolour 1, from $E068 ($0E1C)
the view's horizontal position in pixels within a column (0-7); with $040D it says which part of the level is shown
the view's horizontal position in columns
where the view should move to, fine part; set by the cursor at the screen edge
where the view should move to, column part
this pass's scroll step, fine part, at most one column ($0DDB)
this pass's scroll step, columns (0 or 1)
the eight terrain sprites' X positions, 24 pixels apart, rotated into $D000-$D00E by $0B73
the X positions' ninth bits, built for $D010 by $0B73
counts frames since the last screen swap ($08EF)
$80 when the main loop has drawn the hidden screen and it may be shown ($0E74)
set to 6 by $0C90
which of the two screens is shown: 0 for $4000, 1 for $4400; toggled by the interrupt at each swap ($0904)
the release rate as a step 0-23 ($0B14 down to the level's minimum at $E03C, $0B30 up to 23)
set to $80 by every play interrupt ($08EA); $0DF5 waits on it to count frames
$80 when the keyboard scan at $0A5A found a key down
$80 after a press of DEL (key 11 of the scan table, $0AE7); cleared when $DC01 reads a key at the start of the scan; with $0581 and $0582 it detects DEL pressed twice
counts passes with no key down since DEL was pressed ($0AA6); a second DEL within 8 of them arms the nuke
$80 on a pass with no key down after DEL ($0AA9), so that holding DEL does not count as two presses
$80 once DEL has been pressed twice within 8 key-free passes ($0ADC)
counts passes between steps of the release rate while + or - is held (one step every 7)
$80 while SHIFT is held (key 10 of the scan table; SHIFT LOCK holds it down), cleared at the start of every scan ($0A70): the game is paused
counts 30 passes down once no lemming is left in play; at 0 the level ends ($0F31)
$80 once the level has ended: by time, by the back-arrow key while paused, or with every lemming gone ($0F36, $0ECA)
the scroll column whose terrain characters $0D1F last copied
the scroll position, fine, at the last frame ($0CFF)
the scroll position, columns, at the last frame ($0CF9)
lemmings released so far; when it reaches the level's count at $E039, no more come
the skill chosen with keys 1-8 (0-7), set by $0AB4; also moves the panel's highlight sprite ($0A4A)
the play area's background colour, from the level header at $E05C ($0E1C)
the pause flag copied at the start of the pass ($0E3C): when set, the clock ($0EE9) and $1DD9 are skipped ($0E4E)
$80 from the moment the level ends; stops the play interrupt calling $1916 ($091E)
$80 once the clock has run out ($0EC7)
counts frames in fives up to 50: one second of the clock at $0EE9
jump table of the resident loader (nine JMPs)
reads an eight-byte header at $9000 into zero page $02-$0D
the same with the code from $0700,X, its top three bits forced to 7
loads the file whose code byte is $0400,X: low five bits the second letter of its name, top three bits its kind and disk side
the file is on another disk side than $CB60 says is in the drive: the game's prompt at $5009, then try again
the load failed: the game's handler at $5006, then try again
the first letters of the file names by kind: F T X M P I C S
the disk side each kind is on: F 2, T 3, X 4, M 5 (the four level sides), P, I and C 0 (disk 1), S $FF (any: every level side carries SA-SI)
briefing and end-of-level messages as screen codes, with XX where numbers go; a copy filled in for the current level lies at $5444
